name: Ushigome-Kagurazaka
tagline: Otemachi in 13 minutes and Tokyo in 18 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000.
summary: The station is in Shinjuku City, served by Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 13 minutes to Otemachi, 20 minutes to Shinjuku, 21 minutes to Shibuya and 33 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. The station stands 19 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 18.1 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 19 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 10.8 m to 28.9 m, a difference of 18.1 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 26 clinics and 20 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at JCHO東京新宿メディカルセンター, about 655 m away and 神経研究所附属晴和病院, about 793 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Oedo Line. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.

rentRange.note: One room ¥120,000 to ¥130,000, 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000, 1LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000 and 2LDK ¥350,000 to ¥360,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Kagurazaka is ahead on how close the centre is, but Ushigome-Kagurazaka is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet.
neighbours.note: 345 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 4 minutes sooner than Ushigome-Kagurazaka.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Ushigome-Kagurazaka, but Iidabashi is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: 814 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 7 minutes sooner than Ushigome-Kagurazaka. One-room rents run about ¥17,000 higher.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: 大久保通り (1 lanes each way) runs 1 m away. Morning and evening, the cars are audible indoors
The nearest big road is 早稲田通り, 248 m away, so little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 14 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make: 大久保通り runs 1 m away.
